# Supplemental dependency license texts

Some Cargo registry packages omit their upstream full license files. This directory supplies those texts from upstream revisions recorded in each crate's `.cargo_vcs_info.json`. `license-sources.json` records exact URLs, crate versions and SHA-256 digests. These are license/notice files only; no upstream implementation has been added here. The packaging script includes this directory alongside registry-packaged notices. License choices and remaining review are documented in docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md.

The Windows build uses the system Segoe UI font when available; it is not copied or redistributed. epaint's embedded fonts retain their own OFL/UFL/MIT/Bitstream notices in the registry-packaged license bundle.
